## L1 review · REWORK (patch round 1)

Head-sha: `58100e07dad9b26bbf9f3aef64b5572cf9885cbe` · read 2026-11-24T17:26Z

**Clean at this head.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 37040` CLEAN (13 items): draft, base `main`, `Refs #36454` with no closing keyword, `skip-changeset` with no published package touched, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`, 26 success · 23 expected skip · 0 failed. `check-governed-merges --pr 37040`: NOT governed, 49 lines. Self-test re-run on the head: 812 pass across 30 batteries. Scope is item 2 of #36454 only, as the body says.

**Must fix: one false sentence in the new refusal, and in its docblock.** The text says the amendment arm, on any state but `pm:dispatched`, "is refused (two state labels), nothing written". That holds only for a card that carries another pm STATE label. A card with no pm state label at all is not refused. I ran label-write's own dry run on the head, with a claim body that passes the claim checkers:

| card labels · assignees | arm | label-write dry run |
|---|---|---|
| none · none | amendment (`--add pm:dispatched`) | exit 0, ops `comment > labels_add` |
| `domain:skills` · none | amendment | exit 0, ops `comment > labels_add` |
| `pm:dispatched` · none | amendment | exit 0, ops `comment` |
| `pm:blocked` · none | amendment | exit 2, ONE-OF |
| none · none | dispatch (`… --remove pm:queue --assign LOGIN`) | exit 0, ops `comment > labels_add > assign` |

So on a stateless card the amendment arm dispatches the card with no assignee and writes nothing that fails loudly, which is the half-state the refusal exists to prevent. The dispatch arm is the right one there. The dev report repeats the same claim ("refuses the same arm with ONE-OF … on any other state").

Asked:
1. In `claimStrokeRefusalText` and its docblock (and the header docblock near L489 if it keeps the "any other state" reading), scope the refusal sentence to "another pm state", and say a card with no pm state takes the first arm. Naming the first arm "a card not yet dispatched (`pm:queue` or no pm state)" would do it.
2. Add a control in the claim-stroke battery: the amendment arm through label-write on a card with no pm state packs `labels_add` with no `assign`, and the dispatch arm on that card packs `assign`. Move the battery pin to match.

Nothing else is asked. The cross-tool coupling to label-write's `parseOptions`/`runLabelWrite` is fine as a deliberate pin. Same claim, same dev, patch round.
